# Recorded `claude` output

`plugin-list.json` is `claude plugin list --json` as Claude Code 2.1.330 printed it, cut to three of the
plugins installed and with the home directory replaced by `/home/u`. The other two are written by hand from
it: `plugin-list-disabled.json` has `contour-workflows@contour-terminal` with `"enabled": false`, and
`plugin-list-without.json` leaves it out.
